title: festuca gallica var. costei
intro: Festuca gallica var. costei, commonly known as sheep's fescue, is a perennial grass plant belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the reduction of inflammation, improved digestion, and relief from anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Festuca gallica var. costei are attributed to its ability to act as a sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, while its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant, and it should be used with caution due to potential interactions with medications.
